scripts.build: pnpm build:viewer && vite build && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:viewer: vite build --config vite.viewer.config.ts && vite build --config vite.theme.config.ts && node scripts/sync-viewer.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint src scripts vite.config.ts vite.viewer.config.ts vite.theme.config.ts --deny-warnings
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
